name: Atari 5200 SuperSystem
description: Atari's 1982 follow-up to the 2600, built from the same chipset as its Atari 400/800 home computers. It offered much better graphics and sound, but its fragile, non-centering analog controllers and lack of 2600 compatibility at launch hurt it.
curiosities: Despite sharing hardware with the Atari 400/800, it cannot run their cartridges directly.
The original model had four controller ports; a later revision cut it to two.
Its analog joysticks do not spring back to centre.
Its controllers included a numeric keypad and Start, Pause and Reset keys.
